_note: Owned SFX library (ElevenLabs-generated 2026-08-05, one-time). Reference by name in a scene's 'sfx' field. Use sparingly: hook, reveals, payoff. Never recreate these; add new ones here only when a video genuinely needs a sound that does not exist yet.
whoosh: punchy cartoon swish. Scene transitions, fast reveals, the hook.
pop: single comedic bubble pop. Small reveals, items appearing.
slam: heavy comedic thud/stamp. Verdicts, laws passing, dramatic beats.
ding: bright success chime. Wins, correct answers, payoff moments.
click-type: mouse click + keyboard burst. Search/computer scenes.
paper-rip: quick paper tear. Repeals, cancellations, contracts dying.
